title: Checking x² sin x against 2x sin x + x² cos x
caption: Wolfram|Alpha returns 2x sin x + x² cos x. At x = 2 the product-rule formula gives 1.973, which is the slope of the curve there, and the second curve is that formula for every x.
alt: The curve y = x² sin x and the curve of its derivative 2x sin x + x² cos x, with the point x = 2 marked.
description: Plot the returned derivative 2x sin x + x² cos x.
At x = 2 the derivative's value 1.973 equals the slope of f.
Where f has a turning point the derivative crosses zero.
